flood_skill_hand.source: etl/sdg/flood_eval_counts.py, results in data/processed/sdg/flood_eval/ (project note: sdg-checklist-2026-10-21, section A)
flood_skill_hand.design: HAND flood rule scored against Copernicus GFM observed flood extent, 100 m, train 2019-21, test 2022-26; 5,820 of 5,839 scene-tile items scored (19 unreadable)
flood_skill_hand.reading: Raw and corrected DEM give the same flood skill. The HAND rule itself is weak. The confidence interval for corrected-better days includes 0.

label_year_vs_imagery.source: golden table coverage check (project note: golden-dataset-coverage, section 7)
label_year_vs_imagery.reading: 915,983 rows (75.0%) with 2018-2021 labels use 2022 imagery. Only 2022 and 2023 labels (24.9%) match the imagery year. Counts are from the old 1,221,354-row table.
